text: Fictional Northstar Learning handbook. Full-time employees receive 22 days of annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused days can carry forward until March 31. Leave requests go to the employee's manager at least 7 days before the planned absence.

Fictional Northstar Learning expense policy. Submit expense claims within 30 days of purchase. A receipt is required for purchases above 25 credits. The learning allowance is 600 credits per employee per year. A manager must approve a course before purchase.

Fictional Northstar Learning remote-work policy. Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Team collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in the team's local timezone. Working from another country requires written HR approval before travel.

Fictional Northstar Learning security policy. Never share passwords or access tokens. Report a lost company laptop to the service desk immediately. Company laptops must use disk encryption. Customer information may only be stored in approved company systems.

Fictional Northstar Learning support guide. The service desk operates Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 local time. Urgent incidents involving lost devices use the on-call hotline outside these hours. Standard software requests are normally reviewed within 2 business days.
